objectives.summary: EquiLink aims to create a centralized platform for the equestrian community, addressing the current disconnection and lack of resources. The project has specific milestones, including a beta launch and the introduction of an Emergency Relief Network by the end of Year 1, followed by EquiLink Experiences in Year 2.
key_points: EquiLink's mission is to unite riders, professionals, businesses, and opportunities into one seamless platform.
The project aims to support equestrians in times of crisis through an Emergency Relief Network by the end of Year 1.
In Year 2, EquiLink plans to launch EquiLink Experiences, which will include equestrian adventures, seminars, mentorship programs, fundraising, and networking events.
The project emphasizes the goal of leaving the horse world better than it was found.
EquiLink aims to provide expert content to help riders grow at every level.
The project seeks support to build a strong foundation and grow the right way.

innovation.summary: The EquiLink platform is an innovative mobile app designed for the equestrian community, functioning as a digital hub for users. It features a Knowledge Hub for educational content, an Opportunity Board for collaborations, and a directory of equestrian businesses tailored to user needs.

The platform serves as a digital barn aisle, bringing together members of the equestrian community.

The Opportunity Board facilitates collaborations, sponsorships, and growth opportunities in the equestrian space.
An Events Calendar allows users to discover and attend local shows, clinics, and gatherings.
